generator.prompt: Create a production-quality final game character asset, not concept art and not a rough prototype. Full-body goblin shaman for a premium stylized fantasy action RPG, painterly 2D character cutout with crisp hand-painted materials and highly resolved details. Distinct readable silhouette at gameplay scale: short hunched goblin, expressive angular face, carved wooden ritual mask raised above the forehead, layered weathered teal and ochre robes, leather belts and pouches, bone charms, crooked wooden staff topped with a luminous emerald crystal, subtle green magical glow confined close to the crystal. Three-quarter isometric view, facing down-right, neutral ready/idle pose, every limb and the entire staff fully visible, anatomically coherent hands and feet, consistent perspective, professional game-production polish comparable to a finished premium indie character sprite. Strong shape language, controlled value grouping, clean edges, no excessive micro-noise. Place the isolated character on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background for deterministic chroma-key removal. No ground plane, no cast shadow, no vignette, no environment, no border, no UI, no labels, no typography, no watermark, no extra objects, no cropped extremities. Square image with generous even padding around the full silhouette.
